newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE nearby canola ends down on weaker CBOT soyoil.
newsitem.headline: WCE nearby canola ends down on weaker CBOT soyoil.

text.p: WCE nearby canola futures ended lower on weakness in CBOT soyoil, traders said.

"Chicago soyoil weighed on us. The market was overbought after we hit commission buy stops. There were hedges at the close," a trader said. July WCE futures crush margin fell to +3.97 Friday from +7.40 Thursday. About 300 July-Aug spread from $0.30 to even money, 200 Sep-Nov $3.50, Nov-Jan $4, July Nov $34.50. Volume was 3,000 lots.
Japan bought 10,000 tonnes canola overnight, sources said.
July canola closed $1.30 lower at $409.90, August fell $1.60 to $409.50 and November settled up $0.70 at $377.70.
July flax lost $0.80 to $331.20 as PCTS bought 250 and November fell $0.10 to $321.60 on hedge selling, traders said.
July western barley was unchanged at $132.50 on late commercial demand while October ended up $0.40 at $133.90.
Commercials bought July wheat up $0.20 late at $159 while October rose $0.70 to close at $161. Volume was 240.
Ten October feed pea contracts traded up US$1.50, closing at US$187.50 and 20 December peas rose US$1 to US$188.50 on commercials.
Commercials bought 10 October oats up US$2 at US$118.
(All prices in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats, peas).
